title: MobbyHill
note: Owner pick for this week. MobbyHill is a single file wireframe off road game. The menu goes vehicle (side by side, Jeep, pickup), map (Mob the mountain, forest, canyon, dunes), then challenge (Mob the trail, Mob the hill, Search and rescue with a towed trailer and two teammates), with switches for Fuel challenge, ghost and damage, plus coins, stunts and a store. It loads sdk.js from 2026-10-30-orange-scores.vercel.app for leaderboards and the weekly token wallet. That host already allows itch.io and itch.zone origins, and the game keeps working if the script fails to load. Suggested gate: the demo plays the Jeep on Mob the trail on the mountain in full, and buying unlocks the other two vehicles, the other three maps, Mob the hill, Search and rescue and Fuel challenge.
